title: Exponential rate of convergence of relative value iteration algorithms for ergodic controls of diffusions
summary: In this paper, we investigate the rate of convergence of the relative value iteration (RVI) algorithms for diffusions in $\mathbb{R}^d$ under both the conventional ergodic cost (CEC) and ergodic risk-sensitive cost (ERSC) criteria, and under the uniform exponential stability condition. The existing RVI algorithms for the CEC and ERSC problems solve the associated initial value Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman type equations whose solutions are shown to converge asymptotically to the corresponding optimal values. However, the rates of convergence for such algorithms have remained open. This paper…
